title: Odd majority influence and error term
statement: For every natural number $m$, the total influence of majority on $2m+1$ sign coordinates equals $\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$ plus its error from this main term, namely the total influence minus $\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$.
